_help: Each output has its own band. Overlap is allowed (here 1.2-3.5 kHz gets both). lowpass/highpass_order: 1=gentle 6 dB/oct, 2=12, 4=24. gain_db trims the whole output; may go above 0 (a peak limiter with ceiling 0.97 prevents clipping, so +3..+6 dB is safe, beyond that it starts to squash loud passages). eq: peaking bands, e.g. {"f": 2500, "gain_db": -3, "q": 1.5}. Edit, then ./tune.sh to apply live.
_help_latency: total_latency_ms: fixed app-to-ear latency the split enforces on BOTH paths, and the value the Citation Split device reports to apps so video players hold the picture back to match. Rebuild+reinstall the driver if you change it. Must exceed the worst Bluetooth latency plus ~100 ms.
_help_sync: sync_on_activate: true (default) = measure with two quiet chirps on every activation, because Bluetooth latency changes each time its stream opens (seen: 157 vs 223 ms minutes apart); "auto" = only if the last measurement is older than sync_max_age_h (risks being tens of ms off); false = never, only ./resync.sh. The Citation Split input is a virtual device, not the microphone.
_help_local: Put machine-specific values (bt_address, and optionally device names) in config.local.json, which is git-ignored and overlaid on this file.
_help_chirps: Fallback probe only -- sync_method "auto" measures from the programme itself and reaches for these just when that gives no usable fix. chirp_band_lo goes out the citation (keep it under its lowpass_hz), chirp_band_hi out the MacBook; both avoid 2-5 kHz, where hearing is most sensitive. chirp_len_s is long to buy back the detection SNR a low beep_level costs. Measurements log 'margin Nx', the correlation peak over the background, needing 6x; if it runs near 6x, raise beep_level. sync_mute: "auto" mutes program audio for chirp measurements except the periodic drift check, true always, false never.
_help_drift: The Bluetooth stack's delay drifts mid-session and the ring buffers cannot see it, so the drift check is acoustic. sync_check_s: first check this long after audio starts (0 disables). If it found less than 8 ms it doubles the wait, up to sync_check_max_s; if it had to correct, it goes back to sync_check_s. A check is postponed up to 120 s while input RMS is above sync_defer_rms, so it lands in a quiet passage where the measurement is cleanest.
_help_passive: sync_method: "auto" (default) measures the delay from the music already playing -- the mic is correlated against what each output was actually sent, so nothing audible is added; "chirp" always uses the chirps; "passive" never does. Each path is read in a band the other barely reaches (below the MacBook's highpass, above the citation's lowpass), overridable with passive_band_lo / passive_band_hi. passive_secs is how much audio each read uses -- longer is more accurate and slower. Measurements log 'confidence Nx', which needs 8x; quiet or very narrow-band material falls short and drops to chirps. pad_remeasure_on_resync: ./resync.sh re-measures the app-to-ear pad with a chirp played into the device; off by default because enforce_total already derives the pad from how far the delay moved.
